**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000 – $850 000  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $950 000 – $1 050 000  

> *The median figure is the most commonly cited “average” for the market, as it represents the middle point of all listings and is less skewed by extremely high‑priced properties. The mean (average) tends to be higher because a handful of very expensive homes pull the number up.*
